notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {3}{U} due to Training Grounds, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
